item.title: BNP announces 7-day mourning
item.description: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has announced seven days of mourning following the death of party chairperson and the country’s first female prime minister Khaleda Zia.The announcement was made by the party's Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi at Evercare Hospital on Tuesday.Black flags would be flown for seven days at the BNP’s central office in Nayapaltan and at party offices across the country. item.description: Chief Adviser Prof Muhammad Yunus has expressed profound shock at the death of three-time former Prime Minister, symbol of the democratic movement and BNP Chairperson Begum Khaleda Zia."At the death of Begum Khaleda Zia, the nation has lost a great guardian. item.title: Khaleda Zia's death creates a political vacuum in country: Fakhrul
item.description: BNP Chairperson Begum Khaleda Zia's death has created a political vacuum in the country, said Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.Speaking at a media briefing at Evercare Hospital, Fakhrul said, ''The mother of democracy and our national guardian left us at 6AM. item.title: JnUCSU election postponed at death of BNP chairperson
item.description: Jagannath University authorities have postponed the Jagannath University Central Students’ Union (JnUCSU) election scheduled for Tuesday (December 30) at the death of BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia.The decision was made at an emergency syndicate meeting held today, Vice-Chancellor Professor Dr Md Rezaul Karim confirmed.Meanwhile, hearing the election suspension, students and candidates started protest, taking position near Vice-Chancellor's residence.

item.title: Chinese Premier expresses condolences over death of Khaleda Zia
item.description: China has expressed deep condolences over the death of BNP Chairperson and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia, paying tribute to her role in Bangladesh's democratic journey and reaffirming continued friendly relations with the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).In a condolence letter addressed to BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman, Chinese Ambassador to Bangladesh Yao Wen said the Chinese leadership mourned the passing of Begum Khaleda Zia, describing her as a steadfast champion of freedom

item.title: Modi expresses deep shock at death of Khaleda Zia
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has expressed deep sorrow at the death of former Prime Minister and BNP Chairperson Begum Khaleda.In a message, he said, "I recall my warm meeting with her in Dhaka in 2015. We hope that her vision and legacy will continue to guide our partnership. item.title: Global media coverage on Khaleda’s demise
item.description: International media outlets are closely covering the death news of Bangladesh's first female Prime Minister and BNP chief Khaleda Zia, with several major news organisations highlighting her contribution for the country.
